title: f120.8: wire SmtpRelayQueue into NNTP POST handler
description:
Wire SmtpRelayQueue into the NNTP POST handler so articles posted via NNTP are relayed to SMTP peers when they have email recipients.

**What:** After a POST command stores the article to IPFS, if the article has To:/Cc: email headers and smtp_relay_queue is configured, enqueue for SMTP relay delivery.

**Algorithm:**
1. Read crates/reader/src/session/commands/post.rs fully
2. Read crates/reader/src/post/pipeline.rs to understand PostPipelineConfig
3. Find where complete_post() is called and the article bytes are stored to IPFS
4. After successful IPFS write, parse To: and Cc: headers from article_bytes:
   - Extract RFC 5322 addresses using mail_parser or string parsing (simple approach: find 'To: ' header, split on comma, strip angle-brackets)
   - Filter out Usenet-style recipients (those matching newsgroup.format like 'comp.lang.rust') — only relay true email addresses (those containing '@')
5. If email_rcpt_list is non-empty and smtp_queue is Some:
   - Extract MAIL FROM from From: header (first address)
   - smtp_queue.enqueue(article_bytes, &mail_from, &email_rcpt_list).await — non-fatal on error
6. Add smtp_relay_queue: Option<Arc<SmtpRelayQueue>> to PostPipelineConfig or session context
7. Thread smtp_relay_queue through from reader server startup config to POST handler

**Defensive programming rules:**
- SMTP enqueue failure MUST NOT fail the NNTP POST — article was accepted, return 240 regardless
- Only relay to email addresses (containing '@') — never relay to newsgroup paths
- Non-fatal: on enqueue error, log at warn level only

**Tests:**
- Test: POST handler with smtp_queue=None does not create queue files (oracle: file system)
- Test: POST handler with article containing To: user@example.com — queue gets .env file
- Test: POST handler with article containing To: comp.lang.rust (newsgroup path) — no enqueue
- Test: POST handler with smtp_queue=Some but article parse fails — POST still returns 240

**Acceptance:**
- cargo test -p usenet-ipfs-reader passes
- cargo test -p usenet-ipfs-smtp passes
- cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings passes
- NNTP POST with email To: header enqueues in relay queue
